# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first portrait browser game called Shrinebound Vale: Hero of the Verdant Relic. Preserve the implemented mechanics of a Three.js top-down/free-roam action adventure: joystick movement, camera-relative controls, melee/ranged attacks, mount summon/enter/driving, generated ruin collisions, hearts-based health, curse/wanted escalation, guardian pursuit, death, and retry. Reinterpret the loop through this prompt: Zelda RPG adventure. A Zelda RPG adventure game with mythic overworld exploration, puzzle dungeons, item-gated progression, hidden secrets, heroic questing, environmental puzzle-solving, boss encounters, and a legendary fantasy tone with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The player is a green-cloaked relic hero exploring a mythic moss overworld around sealed dungeon stones. Enemies are cursed shrine sentries; the wanted meter is a temple curse; the car-like traversal system is a sacred relic stag; health is life hearts; defeat is an oath broken. Use browser-native procedural art, fantasy typography, readable mobile HUD panels, large touch controls, ambient relic motifs, and catalog-approved forest/fantasy audio. Do not add item-gated mechanics that the source does not contain; express item-gated progression as truthful tool language through blade, bow, mount, and shrine access framing.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Three.js top-down/free-roam action adventure with arcade combat, health hearts, vehicle/mount traversal, enemy AI, and collision against generated ruin blocks.
- objective: survive and explore the generated overworld, strike or shoot hostile wanderers, summon or enter mounts, and avoid losing all heart health as curse/wanted pressure rises.
- input model: mobile-first virtual joystick for movement, touch buttons for attack, tool switch, summon/enter, camera rotate, and a vertical zoom slider; desktop pointer events share the same controls.
- core loop: start screen -> initialize world/player/NPCs/mounts -> move through ruins -> attack or shoot entities -> defeated enemies raise curse level -> curse spawns pursuing guardian mounts -> damage lowers hearts -> death screen and restart.
- fail/friction state: health reaches zero from hostile projectiles or mount collision, triggering OATH BROKEN feedback and a retry screen; curse stars temporarily intensify pursuit pressure.

## Protected mechanics
- Joystick movement and camera-relative direction mapping.
- Blade/bow attack semantics, damage values, hit tests, and tool switching.
- Summon/enter/exit mount behavior and mount driving physics.
- Building/ruin collision resolution and mount bounce behavior.
- Health, curse/wanted escalation, timed curse decay, guardian spawn pressure, death, restart, and HUD update semantics.
- Start, active play, feedback overlays, game-over, and reload restart state flow.

## Remixed target
Shrinebound Vale: Hero of the Verdant Relic preserves the above loop but frames it as a legendary portrait-first Zelda-like quest: a green-cloaked relic hero explores a moss-lit overworld of sealed shrine stones, battles cursed sentries, summons a sacred stag, and survives a rising temple curse. Presentation surfaces are transformed through mythic HUD language, procedural shrine gates, relic motifs, fantasy typography, mobile-friendly touch controls, and coherent reward/failure vocabulary without changing gameplay rules.
